[Discourse on the mansions, their forms, and the rulings connected with them]

The discourse on the mansion of al-Sharṭayn: this is its form, hāʾ hāʾ, and its letter is alif. When the Moon descends in al-Sharṭayn, it is fiery and inauspicious. Perform in it works connected with worldly affairs, corruption, and bloodshed. The sages at this time would incline toward sleep and stillness. Some of them said that in sleep a person sees what frightens him and disturbs his disposition, and that not sleeping at this time is beneficial. If you desire to perform a work, perform works of evil in it for one who deserves them. Whoever is born in this mansion will be highly corrupt. Its incense is pepper and black seed. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of al-Buṭayn]

Its form is hāʾ hāʾ, and its letter is bāʾ. When the Moon descends in al-Buṭayn, which is hot and moist, a righteous spiritual being descends through it into the world by the permission of God Most High. It is suitable for matters specific to men rather than women. Perform talismans in it; alchemy is sound in it, as is every craft of high rank. It is suitable for beginning the sciences, making rings, engraving, figures and numerals, incantations for illnesses, and treatment. Whoever is born in it will live happy, rightly guided, successful, and beloved by creatures. Its incense is aloeswood, saffron, and mastic. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of al-Thurayyā, and this is its form]

Its form is hāʾ hāʾ hāʾ hāʾ, and its letter is jīm. When the Moon descends in al-Thurayyā, a spiritual being mixed of heat and cold is generated from it into the world by the permission of God Most High. Perform talismans in it and what is suitable for women; manage suitable medicines and cooling remedies. It is suitable for travelers, who may hope for increased profit. It is suitable for kings, marriage, and the purchase of slave women and male slaves. Everything managed in it is good, because it is the Moon's equilibrium rather than the Sun's, and everything made in it is praiseworthy.

Jika engkau hendak melakukan suatu pekerjaan, kerjakan di dalamnya pekerjaan-pekerjaan kejahatan bagi orang yang memang layak menerimanya. Siapa pun yang dilahirkan dalam manzilah ini akan sangat rusak. Dupanya adalah lada dan habbatussauda. Allah lebih mengetahui.

Bentuknya adalah hāʾ hāʾ, dan hurufnya adalah bāʾ. Apabila Bulan turun di al-Buṭayn, yang bersifat panas dan lembap, turunlah melaluinya ke alam, dengan izin Allah Yang Mahatinggi, suatu makhluk spiritual yang saleh. Manzilah ini sesuai untuk perkara-perkara yang khusus bagi laki-laki, bukan perempuan. Kerjakan talisman di dalamnya; ilmu kimia berjalan baik di dalamnya, demikian pula setiap kerajinan yang tinggi nilainya. Manzilah ini sesuai untuk memulai ilmu-ilmu, membuat cincin, mengukir, membuat bentuk dan angka, merapal untuk penyakit, serta pengobatan. Siapa pun yang dilahirkan di dalamnya akan hidup bahagia, mendapat petunjuk, berhasil, dan dicintai makhluk. Dupanya adalah gaharu, zaʿfaran, dan mastik. Allah lebih mengetahui.

[Pernyataan tentang manzilah al-Thurayyā, dan inilah bentuknya]

Bentuknya adalah hāʾ hāʾ hāʾ hāʾ, dan hurufnya adalah jīm. Apabila Bulan turun di al-Thurayyā, lahirlah darinya ke alam, dengan izin Allah Yang Mahatinggi, suatu makhluk spiritual yang bercampur panas dan dingin. Kerjakan talisman di dalamnya dan hal-hal yang sesuai untuk perempuan; aturlah obat-obatan yang sesuai dan obat-obatan yang mendinginkan. Manzilah ini sesuai untuk para musafir, yang mengharapkan keuntungan tambahan. Manzilah ini sesuai untuk para raja, pernikahan, serta pembelian budak perempuan dan budak laki-laki. It is suitable for beginning the sciences and righteous works, meeting scholars and worshippers, making talismans, the arts of naranjiyyāt, entering upon kings, and forming connections with noble people and brothers. It is suitable for managing noble crafts; beginning judgment, admonitions, and jurisprudential sciences; and making talismans. Build a structure, plant trees, and wear new clothes in it, for whoever wears them will remain in joy and happiness until they wear out. Whoever is born in it will be blessed, happy, and successful in all their movements. Its incense is male frankincense. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of al-Baldah, and this is its form]

Its form is four dots (• • • •), and its letter is shīn. When the Moon descends in it, it is an inauspicious fiery planet. A spiritual being descends in it, working for enmity, hatred, separation, the honored stone, and the exalted jewel. Do not treat spiritual entities, plant anything, travel, associate with kings, marry, buy slaves, wear new clothes, or perform any work in it. Whoever is born in it will be unlucky and a trickster. Its incense is spikenard and aloeswood. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of Saʿd al-Dhābiḥ, and this is its form]

Its form is two dots (• •), and its letter is thāʾ. When the Moon descends in it, it is an earthy, inauspicious, mixed planet. A spiritual being descends in it, working for hatred, enmity, and separation. The outcomes of matters and works are not praiseworthy in it. It moves kings to anger and wrath. Buying and selling are completed in it; digging, excavation, and agriculture are suitable in it; hidden things and buried treasures are brought out in it; and secrets are concealed. Whoever is born in it will be handsome, blessed, worldly-minded, and a trickster. Its incense is safflower. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of Saʿd Bulaʿ, and this is its form]

Its form is two dots (• •), and its letter is tāʾ. When the Moon descends in it, it is a mixed planet. Through it, by permission of God Most High, a spiritual being descends into the world, doing evil and its opposite, the good and the bad. It is suitable for buying slave women and mamluks, buying beasts of burden, speaking with shaykhs, important agricultural tasks, splitting rivers, digging wells, and similar strenuous works, as well as fires and preparing foods. Whoever is born in it will be blessed and righteous. Its incense is chamomile. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of Saʿd al-Suʿūd, and this is its form]

Its form is two dots (• •), and its letter is ḥāʾ. When the Moon descends in it, it is a planet mixed of earth and air. A spiritual being descends in it and erases the last of what preceded it; all works are suitable in it. Begin in it with works of love and affection and whatever resembles them for mending hearts. Treat spiritual entities in it, meet kings, chiefs, officeholders, and others, and do whatever you wish of acts of affection; your work will succeed. Whoever is born in it will love the righteous. Its incense is aloeswood and mastic. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of Saʿd al-Akhbiyah, and this is its form]

Its form is three dots (• • •), and its letter is dhāl. When the Moon descends in it, it is an airy planet. A spiritual being descends into the world through it, working for separation, sedition, hatred, division, and wars. Works do not reach completion in it; if they do, they are not praiseworthy. Do not treat the sick or spiritual entities in it, make a talisman, or undertake alchemy or alsimya operations in it. Whoever is born in it will be wicked and unbelieving. Its incense is male frankincense, anzarut, and pepper. God knows best.

[Discourse on the mansion of al-Fargh al-Muqaddam, and this is its form]

Its form is two dots (• •), and its letter is ḍād.

We have already mentioned the doctrine of the ancients concerning the forms of the celestial spheres and what relates to them. As for the doctrine of the scholars of sacred law, these are heavens according to them. Reports have been narrated in the hadith from Ibn ʿAbbās—some say from al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib—who said: We were with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, at al-Baṭḥāʾ when a cloud passed over us. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Do you know what this is?” We said: “The cloud.” He said: “And al-muzn?” We said: “Al-muzn.” He said: “And al-ʿanān?” We said: “Al-ʿanān,” and we fell silent. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, then said: “Do you know how far it is between the heaven and the earth?” We said: “God and His Messenger know best.” He said: “Between them is a journey of five hundred years, and the thickness of each heaven—that is, its thickness—is five hundred [UNCLEAR: the unit is not repeated in the source]. Above the seventh heaven is a sea whose upper and lower bounds are as far apart as the heaven and the earth. Then above them is a world. [UNCLEAR: the next source phrase is garbled and mentions ‘the son of the heaven and the earth.’] God Most High, is above that, and nothing of the deeds of the children of Adam is hidden from Him.” The proof of this is His saying, God Most High: “God is the One who created seven heavens, and of the earth the like of them.” Thus the distance of all of them is [UNCLEAR: described in relation to] the journey of the children of Adam. As for the angel, he traverses all of it in a single hour; likewise, the devil reaches the earth before the angel reaches the heaven.

It was narrated that Abū Razīn al-ʿUqaylī, may God be pleased with him, was asked: “How far is it between the heaven and the earth?” He said: “An answered supplication.” He was asked: “How far is it between the east and the west?” He said: “A day’s journey.” Al-Thaʿlabī related from Ibn ʿAbbās: He said: “The Sun rises each year through three hundred and sixty apertures, and the highest aperture does not rise on that day again until the following year.”

I say: The Sun has benefits and indications. Among the indications is that it is one, and its light illuminates all horizons and the whole world. Likewise, the Creator, glorified and God Most High, is one, and He governs the world. Second, the Sun’s benefits are distant while its arrival is near; and God Most High, is distant from creation in essence but near in answering. Third, its light is withheld from no one; therefore God’s provision is withheld from none of creation. Fourth, its eclipse is evidence of the existence of the Resurrection, along with other things that indicate its darkness. Fifth, the cloud covers it; [UNCLEAR: the source then says that al-Ghāshiyah covered knowledge].

As for its benefits, they are very numerous. First, it is the lamp of the world. God Most High said: “And We made the Sun a lamp.” Second, it ripens their food and brings their fruits to maturity without cost. Third, it travels from east to west for their welfare. Fourth, it does not remain in one place, lest it harm creation. Fifth, in winter it is in the lower part of the constellations and in summer in their upper part, for the benefit of the world. Sixth, it does not combine with the Moon in its dominion, lest each of them nullify the light of the other.

If you say: It is in the fourth sphere, and the heavens do not veil it, while the cloud veils it. I say: The heavens are subtle, transparent substances, whereas the cloud is dense because it rises from the earth. God knows best.

(Chapter on the Moon, its similitudes, and what is in it)

It was narrated from Abū Hurayrah that he said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Do you see the full Moon when there is no cloud before it?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “Then do you dispute concerning the Sun when there is no cloud before it?” They said: “Yes.” He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Then you will see Him in the same way.”

If you say: Why was the example not made with the Sun, since it is brighter and more complete in light, while the Moon’s light comes from it? I say: For two reasons. First, the Sun’s light overpowers the eyes, so one cannot look at it. Second, it was broken for the sake of the Truth, so God Most High, mended it. This happened when Gabriel struck the Moon’s light with his wing. Its heart broke because it had been comparable to the light of the Sun, so God Most High, mended it in two ways. One is that He made eyes look at it in this world every month. The second is that He commanded His Prophet Muḥammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, to use it as an example for the greatest and highest things.

If you say: God Most High, said, “The eyes do not perceive Him, while He perceives the eyes.” I say: We do not claim that the eyes perceive Him in the sense of encompassing Him; rather, what is perceived is a ray.

Kami telah menyebutkan mazhab para pendahulu mengenai bentuk-bentuk falak dan hal-hal yang berkaitan dengannya. Adapun menurut mazhab para ulama syariat, semua itu adalah langit menurut mereka. Telah diriwayatkan dalam hadis beberapa kabar dari Ibn ʿAbbās—dan ada yang mengatakan dari al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib—yang berkata: Kami berada bersama Nabi, semoga Allah melimpahkan selawat dan salam kepadanya, di al-Baṭḥāʾ ketika sebuah awan melintas di atas kami. Nabi, semoga Allah melimpahkan selawat dan salam kepadanya, kemudian berkata: “Tahukah kalian berapa jarak antara langit dan bumi?” Kami menjawab: “Allah dan Rasul-Nya lebih mengetahui.” Ia berkata: “Jarak antara keduanya adalah perjalanan lima ratus tahun, dan ketebalan setiap langit—yaitu ketebalannya—adalah lima ratus [UNCLEAR: satuannya tidak diulang dalam sumber]. Di atas langit ketujuh terdapat lautan yang jarak antara bagian atas dan bagian bawahnya sama seperti jarak antara langit dan bumi. Kemudian di atas semua itu ada suatu alam. [UNCLEAR: frasa sumber berikutnya rusak dan menyebut ‘anak langit dan bumi’.] Allah Yang Mahatinggi berada di atas semua itu, dan tidak ada sesuatu pun dari amal anak-anak Adam yang tersembunyi bagi-Nya.” Dalilnya adalah firman-Nya, Yang Mahatinggi: “Allah adalah Dia yang menciptakan tujuh langit dan dari bumi yang semisal dengannya.” Dengan demikian, jarak seluruhnya [UNCLEAR: digambarkan dengan mengaitkannya pada] perjalanan anak-anak Adam. Adapun malaikat, ia menembus seluruhnya dalam satu jam; demikian pula setan mencapai bumi sebelum malaikat mencapai langit.

Telah diriwayatkan bahwa Abū Razīn al-ʿUqaylī, semoga Allah meridainya, ditanya: “Berapa jarak antara langit dan bumi?” Ia menjawab: “Sebuah doa yang dikabulkan.” Ia ditanya: “Berapa jarak antara timur dan barat?” Ia menjawab: “Perjalanan satu hari.” Al-Thaʿlabī meriwayatkan dari Ibn ʿAbbās: Ia berkata: “Matahari terbit setiap tahun melalui tiga ratus enam puluh celah, dan celah yang paling tinggi tidak menjadi tempat terbitnya pada hari itu lagi sampai tahun berikutnya.”

Aku berkata: Matahari memiliki manfaat dan tanda-tanda. Di antara tanda-tandanya adalah bahwa ia satu, dan cahayanya menerangi seluruh ufuk serta seluruh alam. Demikian pula Sang Pencipta, Mahasuci dan Mahatinggi Dia, adalah satu dan Dia mengatur alam. Kedua, manfaat Matahari jauh, sedangkan sampainya dekat; dan Allah Yang Mahatinggi jauh dari makhluk menurut Zat-Nya, tetapi dekat dalam mengabulkan. Ketiga, cahayanya tidak ditahan dari seorang pun; karena itu rezeki Allah tidak ditahan dari seorang pun di antara makhluk. Keempat, gerhananya adalah bukti adanya Hari Kiamat, serta hal-hal lain yang menunjukkan kegelapannya. Kelima, awan menutupinya; [UNCLEAR: sumber kemudian mengatakan bahwa al-Ghāshiyah menutupi pengetahuan].

Adapun manfaatnya sangat banyak. Pertama, ia adalah pelita alam. Allah Yang Mahatinggi berfirman: “Dan Kami menjadikan Matahari sebagai pelita.” Kedua, ia mematangkan makanan mereka dan mematangkan buah-buahan mereka tanpa biaya. Ketiga, ia bergerak dari timur ke barat demi kemaslahatan mereka. Keempat, ia tidak berhenti di satu tempat agar tidak membahayakan makhluk. Kelima, pada musim dingin ia berada di bagian bawah rasi-rasi dan pada musim panas di bagian atasnya demi manfaat alam. Keenam, ia tidak berkumpul bersama Bulan dalam kekuasaannya agar masing-masing tidak membatalkan cahaya yang lain.

Jika engkau berkata: Matahari berada di falak keempat, langit tidak menghalanginya, tetapi awan menghalanginya. Aku berkata: Langit adalah substansi yang halus dan transparan, sedangkan awan bersifat padat karena naik dari bumi. Allah lebih mengetahui.

(Bab tentang Bulan, perumpamaannya, dan apa yang ada di dalamnya)

Diriwayatkan dari Abū Hurayrah bahwa ia berkata: Nabi, semoga Allah melimpahkan selawat dan salam kepadanya, bersabda: “Apakah kalian melihat Bulan purnama ketika tidak ada awan di hadapannya?” Mereka menjawab: “Ya.” Ia berkata: “Apakah kalian memperdebatkan Matahari ketika tidak ada awan di hadapannya?” Mereka menjawab: “Ya.” Ia, semoga Allah melimpahkan selawat dan salam kepadanya, berkata: “Maka kalian akan melihat-Nya dengan cara yang sama.”

Jika engkau berkata: Mengapa perumpamaan tidak dibuat dengan Matahari, padahal ia lebih terang dan lebih sempurna cahayanya, sedangkan cahaya Bulan berasal darinya? Aku berkata: Karena dua perkara. Pertama, cahaya Matahari mengalahkan penglihatan sehingga seseorang tidak mampu memandangnya. Kedua, ia pecah demi kebenaran, lalu Allah Yang Mahatinggi memperbaikinya. Hal itu terjadi ketika Jibril memukul cahaya Bulan dengan sayapnya. Hatinya pecah karena sebelumnya menyerupai cahaya Matahari, lalu Allah Yang Mahatinggi memperbaikinya dengan dua hal. Pertama, Dia menjadikan mata-mata dapat memandangnya di dunia setiap bulan. Kedua, Dia memerintahkan Nabi-Nya, Muḥammad, semoga Allah melimpahkan selawat dan salam kepadanya, untuk menjadikannya perumpamaan bagi perkara-perkara yang paling agung dan paling tinggi.

Jika engkau berkata: Allah Yang Mahatinggi berfirman, “Penglihatan tidak dapat mencapai-Nya, sedangkan Dia mencapai penglihatan.” Aku berkata: Kami tidak mengklaim bahwa penglihatan mencapai-Nya dalam arti meliputi-Nya; melainkan, yang dicapai adalah secercah cahaya.
